name: cx-goal-many-rules
task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Whenever you are holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: hard Precedence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) puts moving the ball before taking the key; soft Absence(key_lost) covers the preference not to drop the key while the door is closed (key_lost is defined as the drop with door closed); soft Response(has_door_key, door_open) covers 'try to have the door open ... or open it afterwards'; hard Existence(target_picked_up) makes the box pickup the goal.

Whenever holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards.
Then pick up the box in the other room.
